dropped.fuel megawatthours: they are the ingredients of carbon intensity for the same hour
dropped.demand_mwh: known only as the hour happens; the day-ahead forecast is the legal demand input
dropped.per-city sunlight: the five cities move together; replaced by sun_shortwave_mean and sun_diffuse_mean
dropped.direct radiation: shortwave radiation is direct plus diffuse
dropped.wind direction: the demand audit found it was mostly the daily clock
dropped.precipitation: rare at these cities and weak next to cloud cover

emission_factor_source: EPA combustion factors in kg/MMBtu times a typical heat rate in MMBtu/MWh: gas 53.06 * 7.4, coal 95.5 * 10.5, distillate oil 73.96 * 11. A kg per MWh is the same number as a g per kWh. Nuclear, hydro, wind, solar, and geothermal are 0. eGRID publishes yearly plant rates, so it is not an hourly column.
renewable_forecast: CAISO OASIS SLD_REN_FCST, day-ahead market, solar and wind summed across NP15, SP15, and ZP26. Published the afternoon before the operating day. Hours before July 2023 have no forecast and are left empty on purpose.
